text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The moon...? My goodness! It is ginormous 
and so perfectly round~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it look like a giant Tsukimi 
dango? Just looking at it got me so 
excited, I wanted to chase after it~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, when I was little, I also looked up 
to Princess Kaguya and tried to chase 
after her♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If I were Princess Kaguya, I'd just run 
back and forth between the moon and 
Earth...! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hngnhh~~! I suddenly feel a fierce desire 
to run! My legs are itching for action, I 
must say~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Shall we go chase the moon together then?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sounds splendid♪ Trainer, mind if I go for 
a quick sprint?
choice_data_list: I really need to get some rest today

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit! Alright then, we'll 
leave even meteors in the dust!"

The two chased after the moon, running 
right up until curfew...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Indeed, a true lady must not let 
herself be driven by sheer excitement 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, nothing to be done then~. We can 
meet under the full moon again, so let's 
do it next time~☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us let them off the hook for 
today. Next time we meet, I shall overtake 
them completely~!

Under the watchful gaze of the great moon, 
the two made their way back to the dorms.
